thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate + QPS spike for org sablegate (org_id: og_7wx). 5xx rate up ~18% in last 2m, latency up. Alert: rps>baseline x6
maya: acked. pulling logs and rate limiter state
paul: oncall here, looking at gateway metrics... seeing a sudden jump to 2.3k rps from og_7wx, mostly embedding requests. 4xx/429s also rising
jess: embedding heavy usage from client version 2.4. They started a batch job (unknown). Can we confirm path? logs show req.path=/v1/embeddings
samir: if it's a runaway batch we should protect other tenants. propose temporary org-level throttle to 800 qps and increase token quota to 200k/min for them? or inverse: cap to 800 qps overall.
maya: +1 to cap. also can we disable streaming for that org? that will drastically reduce concurrency
paul: I can apply a quick override. two mitigation options:
1) org_quota_override: set qps=800, burst=1200
2) disable embeddings for org (route to 403)
what's preference? urgent
jess: disabling embeddings could break customer's job. prefer soft throttle + notif to SEs
samir: +1 soft throttle. we should also add a temporary billing alert for the SE to reach out
paul: running command now:
```
# emergency override
rctl org-override apply --org og_7wx --qps 800 --burst 1200 --reason "emergency spike 1765432100"
```
paul: command return: 200 OK, override_id=ov_9z1, took 2.1s
ops-bot: action: org_quota_override applied for og_7wx by paul (ov_9z1) :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Note: Auto-fallback routing active, compatible-model small-embed selected for overflow
maya: monitoring: 5xx rate dropping, latency improving. current rps from og_7wx down to ~760
jess: reached out to SE on Slack thread with customer contact. asked them to pause job
chen: pulled request logs, client job still trying at same rate but now seeing 429s; that's expected
samir: timeline: applied override at 1765432154. We should keep it for 30m and reassess. I recommend adding a temporary 2x quota cap for burst window if they have an urgent need
maya: agreed. set follow-up: if their SE confirms it was a mistake, revert. else plan a limited quota bump with manual approval
paul: created incident ticket INC-2026-234 in tracker with notes + override_id
jess: SE replied — they confirm batch job misconfigured. they'll stop it and request a controlled increase later
ops-bot: metrics: errors down to 1.8% from 18% in 10m. QPS for org at 690 now
samir: can we add an action to run a retrospective and add detection rule for sudden embedding bursts? we should auto-notify customer's billing owner too
maya: filed follow-up task in backlog: detect-high-embedding-burst - owner: eng-ml. link: https://issues.redwood.local/UX-1123
paul: handing off to night oncall @samir for monitoring. I'll be available if rollback needed. :thumbsup:
samir: taking handoff. will monitor alerts and escalate to eng-sre if things regress
incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. next update scheduled +30m
jess: doc note: customer impact: degraded embeddings for SableGate only, other tenants unaffected. communicated to SE.
maya: will remove override when customer confirms or after 30m. keep thread updated.
paul: closing console actions for now. thanks team :heart:
